Product description

Product Description

Aromatic, expertly roasted, and designed for a larger cup, this Americano blend is perfectly balanced and hits the spot when you need that extra boost of delicious coffee. Delivering the finest coffee since 1923, Kenco has been dedicated to creating quality flavours for you to savour. With a wide array of blends to choose from, Kenco expert coffee roasters ensure that everyone gets to enjoy a taste that's just right for them. Tassimo coffee machines use Intellibrew™ Technology that recognizes your pod at the touch of a button, adjusts to the perfect size, temperature and intensity to create a perfect drink for you to enjoy. Tassimo is the result of when great brewers and great drinks come together. Bringing joy into your everyday moments, Tassimo creates coffee you'll love.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love these coffee pods for their taste, noting they're not bitter, and appreciate the XL size that provides a full mug of coffee. The coffee is strong and makes a great cup, with one customer mentioning it works well with milk to make a latte. While many customers find the pods work well, some report issues with two out of three pods not functioning properly.

    Buying in bulk is FAR cheaper than any branded store! 5* taste at a 5* price...
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 10 August 2025
    Flavour Name: Americano Grande XLSize Name: 16 count (Pack of 5)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Rich, smooth, and satisfyingly bold—perfect XL cup for busy mornings

    The Tassimo Kenco Americano Grande XL pods are a fantastic choice for coffee lovers who want a full-sized, café-style brew without the fuss. Each pod delivers a generous cup with a smooth, well-balanced flavour that’s bold enough to wake you up, but not overpowering.

    The aroma is inviting from the moment it starts brewing, and the taste is consistently rich with subtle roasted notes. It’s not bitter or acidic—just a clean, satisfying Americano that pairs beautifully with breakfast or powers you through a mid-afternoon slump.

    The XL size is a real win. Unlike standard pods that leave you wanting more, this one fills a proper mug and still tastes great. No watered-down compromise, just a full-bodied coffee with depth. It’s ideal for anyone who prefers quantity without sacrificing quality.

    Compatibility with the Tassimo machine is flawless—pop in the pod, press the button, and enjoy. No mess, no measuring, and no waiting around.

    If you’re after a reliable, flavourful Americano with a generous pour, the Kenco Grande XL is a top-tier pick. Great value, great taste, and great convenience.

Product description

Product Description
Aromatic, expertly roasted, and designed for a larger cup, this Americano blend is perfectly balanced and hits the spot when you need that extra boost of delicious coffee. Delivering the finest coffee since 1923, Kenco has been dedicated to creating quality flavours for you to savour. With a wide array of blends to choose from, Kenco expert coffee roasters ensure that everyone gets to enjoy a taste that's just right for them. Tassimo coffee machines use Intellibrew™ Technology that recognizes your pod at the touch of a button, adjusts to the perfect size, temperature and intensity to create a perfect drink for you to enjoy. Tassimo is the result of when great brewers and great drinks come together. Bringing joy into your everyday moments, Tassimo creates coffee you'll love.
